daily.0.0.b: Don't stare at me like that. Look at the puzzle.
daily.0.1.a: I heard your footsteps from the other side of the screen.
daily.0.1.b: If you're playing, don't make too many mistakes. The sound of erasing is irritating.
daily.0.2.a: I'm not crawling out of the TV again today.
daily.0.3.b: I thought this house would drive you away before it managed to get rid of me.
daily.0.4.b: And don't touch the cells that already have numbers. Both are irritating.
daily.1.0.b: At least I don't have to call you through the TV.
daily.1.0.q: Will you stay with me for a while today?
daily.1.1.b: Don't get smug. I only said acceptable.
daily.1.1.q: What do you want to do next?
daily.1.2.b: It's not hard enough to run away from. Probably.
daily.1.2.q: What do you want to do today?
daily.1.3.a: You're starting to give me fewer headaches.
daily.1.3.q: What do you want to do today?
daily.1.4.a: Yesterday you did better than I expected.
daily.2.0.a: I saved this puzzle for you.
daily.2.0.b: Don't make me regret choosing it.
daily.2.1.a: You came home later than yesterday.
daily.2.1.b: I... only noticed. The clock in here is loud.
daily.2.1.q: Sit with me for a while?
daily.2.2.b: This puzzle suits you better than the earlier ones. I chose it a little more carefully.
daily.2.2.q: What do you want to do with me?
daily.2.3.b: Maybe I should find harder puzzles before you start getting pleased with yourself.
daily.2.4.a: The house was too quiet today.
daily.2.4.b: Good thing you're home. ...I mean the noise, that's all.
daily.2.4.q: Sit with me for a while?
daily.3.0.b: ...Good. I was starting to think this room was too quiet.
daily.3.0.q: Will you stay with me today?
daily.3.1.b: Not exactly because I missed you. The house was just quiet... though it wasn't entirely not because I missed you.
daily.3.2.a: I'm starting to understand why living people like small routines.
daily.3.2.b: You come home, I give you a puzzle, the house makes noise again. Repeating it... is rather pleasant.
daily.3.2.q: Sit with me for a while?
daily.3.3.a: I kept this spot for you.
daily.3.3.b: Don't make me say out loud that I like having someone sit with me.
daily.3.4.a: I picked a puzzle that's just difficult enough.
daily.3.4.b: I want to see how much further you've improved... before I have to find something nastier.
daily.3.4.q: What do you want to do with me today?
daily.4.0.b: You solved everything I brought with me... and you still came back.
daily.4.0.q: Will you still stay with me today?
daily.4.1.a: I don't have any more Stages to use as an excuse to keep you here.
daily.4.1.b: ...I can find more puzzles. Or perhaps we don't need one.
daily.4.2.a: Perhaps I've run out of reasons to make you stay.
daily.4.2.b: Good thing you don't seem to need a reason anymore.
daily.4.2.q: Stay with me for a while?
daily.disabled.question: Sudoku looks away.
daily.repeat.0.q: Want to stay a little longer?
daily.repeat.1.q: Anything else you want to do?
daily.repeat.2.a: I still have the puzzle here.
daily.solved.question.close: Do you still want to stay with me a little longer today?
daily.solved.question.early: Want to stay a little longer?
hub.opening: Sudoku watches you, waiting for you to speak.
hub.question: ...What do you want to do today?
hub.trust.already: Trust {{trust}}/30 • you've already spent time talking together today.
intro.0.line1: Sudoku stares at you without blinking.
intro.0.question: How do you answer?
intro.pencil.normal.1: Sudoku is silent for a few seconds.
intro.pencil.question: What do you give her?
intro.pencil.tv.2: Sudoku glances at the TV. "...It is easier to understand than you."

roommate.activity-label.wait: Waiting for you to come home
roommate.activity.corner.0.b: From here I can hear the wood creak, the fire crackle... and even when you walk past.
roommate.activity.corner.1.b: This corner simply gets less traffic. A little quiet makes the thoughts in my head less tangled.
roommate.activity.corner.2.b: Living people sometimes sit perfectly still and do nothing too, don't they? I'm trying it.
roommate.activity.door.0.b: I can tell you're coming home while your footsteps are still far away, before your hand ever reaches the knob.
roommate.activity.door.1.b: In, out, close, open... very orderly. Very principled.
roommate.activity.door.2.a: I'm only standing here for a little while.
roommate.activity.door.2.b: ...I'm not waiting for you. It just means I'll know first if you happen to come home.
roommate.activity.furniture.0.b: Living people own an impressive number of things whose only purpose is to hold other things. It's confusing.
roommate.activity.furniture.2.a: I'm watching the house change little by little.
roommate.activity.furniture.2.b: You drag things around all day, clattering everywhere... and by night it's a different house again.
roommate.activity.listen.0.b: During the day it clicks and murmurs softly. At night, every settling board becomes much clearer.
roommate.activity.listen.1.a: There are tiny, regular clicks inside the walls.
roommate.activity.listen.1.b: Usually I reach seventy-three before you open the door. Today I only reached seventy-one.
roommate.activity.listen.2.a: The house sounds different when you're here.
roommate.activity.listen.2.b: Not exactly louder. The noises have more rhythm, as though the house knows someone is living inside it.
roommate.activity.pet.0.b: I think it knew I was here long before you finally looked straight at me.
roommate.activity.pet.1.a: This animal isn't afraid of me at all.
roommate.activity.pet.1.b: ...I still haven't decided whether that's a compliment or a tiny insult.
roommate.activity.pet.2.a: Its eyes keep following me, slowly from one side to the other.
roommate.activity.pet.2.b: Perhaps it likes me more than you. I'm only considering the possibility.
roommate.activity.tv.0.b: When it's off, the room reflects faintly in the glass. It almost looks like a doorway.
roommate.activity.tv.1.a: The TV crackled with static when you walked in.
roommate.activity.tv.1.b: That wasn't me. ...At least not this time.
roommate.activity.tv.2.b: It reflects the house rather clearly. You too... even while you keep pacing around.
roommate.activity.wait.0.a: I'm waiting for you to come home.
roommate.activity.wait.0.b: ...Yes. Waiting. There's no need to rename it to make it less awkward.
roommate.activity.wait.1.a: I've kept the spot beside me empty.
roommate.activity.wait.1.b: No special reason. It's just... if you come home, I won't have to make room.
roommate.activity.wait.2.a: I was going to pick out a puzzle for you.
roommate.activity.wait.2.b: Then I remembered we don't actually need to solve anything just to sit together.
roommate.strange.0.a: The TV flashed a frame I've never seen before.
roommate.strange.0.b: Just a pitch-black hallway and a half-open door. I turned it off before anything could step through.
roommate.strange.1.a: Something was standing outside the door earlier.
roommate.strange.1.b: Tall, perfectly still. I looked away for a moment, and when I looked back it was gone.
roommate.strange.2.a: The mirror in the house is reflecting you one beat late.
roommate.strange.2.b: Only one beat. ...Don't stand in front of it too long today.
roommate.strange.3.a: The animal keeps staring over your shoulder.
roommate.strange.3.b: I'm not standing there. And I don't intend to turn around and check what is.
roommate.strange.4.a: Last night there was a knock... knock... from inside the TV.
roommate.strange.4.b: Three knocks, a pause, then three more. I didn't answer.
roommate.talk.0.0.b: I don't have anything special to say. But if you want to sit there for a while... sit.
roommate.talk.0.1.a: Living people really do talk a lot.
roommate.talk.0.1.b: You, though... you're only loud enough to be tolerable.
roommate.talk.0.2.b: I haven't asked why you grow an entire field of turnips as though your life depends on it.
roommate.talk.0.3.a: No puzzle, and you're still standing here?
roommate.talk.0.3.b: ...You're strange in a very living-person sort of way.
roommate.talk.1.0.b: I only noticed. Don't read too much into it.
roommate.talk.1.1.a: I'm starting to recognize your footsteps.
roommate.talk.1.1.b: Quick at first, then slower just before the door. Easy to recognize.
roommate.talk.1.2.a: You have a very strange habit.
roommate.talk.1.2.b: You come back every day to talk to a ghost, and act as though that's perfectly normal.
roommate.talk.1.3.a: This house isn't as quiet as it used to be.
roommate.talk.1.3.b: Doors, footsteps, furniture clattering... strangely, I don't hate it.
roommate.talk.2.0.a: I was going to tell you something.
roommate.talk.2.0.b: ...Then the thought drifted away. Ask tomorrow. Maybe it'll come back.
roommate.talk.2.1.b: You don't have to tell me everything. Pick one thing... I'll listen.
roommate.talk.2.2.a: I think I've gotten used to the sound of the door when you come home.
roommate.talk.2.2.b: Don't replace it. That creak... is easy to recognize.
roommate.talk.2.3.a: You don't have to bring out a puzzle every time.
roommate.talk.2.3.b: Some days, sitting quietly for a while is enough. I won't keep score.
roommate.talk.3.0.b: ...Good. The house was quieter than it needed to be.
roommate.talk.3.1.a: I like the days when you stay home longer.
roommate.talk.3.1.b: Wait. Pretend you didn't hear that.
roommate.talk.3.2.a: Maybe living people call this... familiarity.
roommate.talk.3.2.b: Something repeats and repeats, until one day its absence feels empty.
roommate.talk.3.3.a: If one day I'm not standing by the TV anymore...
roommate.talk.3.3.b: You'd still come looking for me, wouldn't you? ...You don't have to answer now.
roommate.talk.4.0.a: I don't need Sudoku to keep you sitting here anymore, do I?
roommate.talk.4.0.b: ...Good. I was getting tired of pretending that was the reason.
roommate.talk.4.1.b: I'm not denying it this time. Denying things gets tiring.
roommate.talk.4.2.a: This house used to be yours alone.
roommate.talk.4.2.b: Now... there are a few corners that feel familiar enough to be mine too.
roommate.talk.4.3.a: We don't have to play today.
roommate.talk.4.3.b: I only wanted to know you made it home. That's enough.
roommate.welcome.0.0: Sudoku turns her head slightly. "...You're home."
roommate.welcome.0.1: Sudoku looks toward the door. "I heard your footsteps from outside."
roommate.welcome.1.0: Sudoku watches you for a moment. "You came home later than usual today."
roommate.welcome.1.1: "...You're home." Sudoku gives a small nod and returns to what she was doing.
roommate.welcome.2.0: Sudoku tilts her head slightly. "You're home. ...Good."
roommate.welcome.2.1: "I knew you'd come back." Sudoku says it as though it were obvious.
roommate.welcome.3.0: "You're home." Sudoku's shoulders relax, just slightly.
roommate.welcome.3.1: Sudoku looks over at you. "I waited for you." This time she doesn't add anything to take it back.
